title: Most goals in a Champions League season
brief: Name the ten players with the most goals in a single Champions League season since 1992/93. Each player counts once, for his best season.
period: Champions League seasons 1992/93 to 2025/26, group or league stage onwards

notes.Sebastien Haller: Sebastien Haller is next with 11 in 2021/22.
notes.Neymar: Neymar's best season was 10 goals, in 2014/15.
notes.Kaka: Kaka's best season was 10 goals, in 2006/07.
notes.Alessandro Del Piero: Alessandro Del Piero's best season was 10 goals, in 1997/98.
notes.Mohamed Salah: Mohamed Salah's best season was 10 goals, in 2017/18.
notes.Zlatan Ibrahimovic: Zlatan Ibrahimovic's best season was 10 goals, in 2013/14.

checks: Each player season total from UEFA.com matches the Transfermarkt season scorer list; the Wikipedia single-season table agrees. Van Nistelrooy (2002/03), Gomez (2011/12) and Haaland (2022/23) share ninth on 12, so any two of them fill the last two places.
